tip_start_sale_body: Thepha lapha ukuze uqale ukuthengisa. Skena nje ibhakhodi, intengo izihlanganisele wena.
tip_today_summary_body: Lokhu kukhombisa okuthengisile namuhla. Hlola njalo kusihlwa ukuze ubone imali oyitholile.
tip_dash_latest_body: Lokhu ukuthengisa kwakho kwakamuva. Thepha 'Bona konke' ukuze ubuyekeze izinsuku ezedlule.
tip_dash_compliance_body: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi isitolo sakho silungele kangakanani ukuhlolwa. Thepha ukuze ubone okusadinga ukwenziwa.
tip_dash_journey_body: Lokhu kulandelela inqubekela phambili yakho ukuze ube nesitolo esisemthethweni ngokugcwele. Thepha ukuze uqhubeke nesinyathelo esilandelayo.
tip_sales_start_body: Thepha lapha ukubhala ukuthengisa — skena izinto, isamba sizihlanganisela wena.
tip_sales_today_body: Bona ukuthi kungakanani okuthengisile namuhla, ngokushesha.
tip_sales_weekly_body: Leli shadi likhombisa ukuthengisa kwakho usuku ngalunye kuleli viki, ukuze ubone izinsuku zakho ezimatasa.
tip_sales_top_body: Lezi yizinto ezithengiswa kakhulu kuleli viki. Zigcine zikhona empahleni!
tip_sales_history_body: Thepha lapha ukubona konke ukuthengisa kunoma yiluphi usuku olukhethayo.
tip_sales_stats_body: Thepha lapha ukubona okuthengiswa kakhulu nokuncane, inzuzo, kanye nokuthambekela esikhathini osikhethayo.
tip_inventory_body: Thepha lapha ukungeza imikhiqizo, ubale impahla, ubone okuncipha kakhulu.
tip_inv_products_body: Thepha lapha ukungeza imikhiqizo nokubeka amanani nezindleko zayo.
tip_inv_expiry_body: Thepha lapha ukubona imikhiqizo esondele osukwini lokuphelelwa ukuze kungachithwa lutho.
tip_inv_counts_body: Lezi zinombolo zikhombisa inani lemikhiqizo yakho, okuncane, nokuphelelwa.
tip_inv_stocktake_body: Thepha lapha ukubala lokho okusemashalofini akho ngempela bese ulungisa noma yimuphi umehluko.
tip_inv_suppliers_body: Thepha lapha ukugcina ukuthi uthenga kubani, ukuze uku-oda kabusha kube lula.
tip_stock_scan_body: Thepha lapha ukuskena ibhakhodi bese ugxumela ngqo empahleni yalowo mkhiqizo.
tip_stock_search_body: Thayipha igama noma ibhakhodi lapha ukuze ugxumele ngqo emkhiqizweni.
tip_stock_tabs_body: Shintsha phakathi kwazo zonke izinto, impahla encane, nezinto eziphelelwa maduze.
tip_stock_summary_body: Lezi zikhombisa inani lemikhiqizo yakho, impahla encane, ephelile, nephelelwayo.
tip_sd_adjust_body: Sebenzisa 'Ngeza' uma kufika impahla entsha, futhi 'Susa' ukulimala noma ukulahleka.
tip_sd_quick_body: Thepha inani elivamile ukuze ugcwalise ngokushesha, noma uthayiphe elakho ngezansi.
tip_sd_batches_body: Ngeza amaqoqo nezinsuku zawo zokuphelelwa lapha, ukuze i-Movestock ikuxwayise ngaphambi kokuba aphelelwe.
tip_product_add_body: Thepha lapha ukufaka umkhiqizo omusha — wunike igama, intengo, nebhakhodi.
tip_products_import_body: Thepha lapha ukungeza imikhiqizo evamile ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthayipha konke.
tip_products_search_body: Thayipha igama noma ibhakhodi lapha ukuthola umkhiqizo ohlwini lwakho.
tip_products_row_body: Thepha noma yimuphi umkhiqizo ukuze ushintshe igama lawo, intengo, izindleko, noma impahla.
tip_manage_staff_body: Thepha lapha ukungeza abathengisi bese unika ngamunye i-PIN yokungena.
tip_manage_body: Thepha lapha ukubona izinyathelo zokubhalisa isitolo sakho ngokugcwele futhi sibe semthethweni.
tip_manage_compliance_body: Thepha lapha ukuhamba phezu kwalokho umhloli abengakubheka.
tip_stat_range_body: Khetha usuku lokuqala nolokugcina ukuze ubone ukuthengisa kwaleso sikhathi.
tip_stat_tiles_body: Ukuthengisa, izinto ezithengisiwe, imali engenile, nenzuzo yezinsuku ozikhethile.
tip_stat_trend_body: Bona ukuthi imali yakho oyitholayo ikhuphuka futhi yehla kanjani ngesikhathi.
tip_stat_top_body: Bona ukuthi yimiphi imikhiqizo ethengiswa kakhulu — neyiphi enganyakazi.
tip_stat_pdf_body: Thepha lapha ukulanda lo mbiko ukuze uwabelane noma uwugcine.
tip_hist_date_body: Sebenzisa imicibisholo noma ikhalenda ukuze ukhethe ukuthengisa kwaluphi usuku ofuna ukukubona.
tip_hist_list_body: Thepha noma yikuphi ukuthengisa ukuze ukuvule ubone izinto ezathengiswa.
tip_hist_totals_body: Inani lokuthengisa, imali engenile, nenzuzo yosuku olubukayo.
tip_hist_pdf_body: Landa ukuthengisa kwenyanga ephelele njenge-PDF ukuze uwugcine noma uwabelane.
tip_low_stock_body: Ezinye izinto seziya ngokuncipha. Thepha lapha ukuze uhlole impahla uphinde u-oda.
tip_expiring_body: Eminye imikhiqizo isondele osukwini lokuphelelwa. Thepha lapha ukubona ukuthi yiziphi.
tip_missing_cost_body: Faka intengo oyikhokhayo kumkhiqizo ngamunye ukuze i-Movestock ikhombise inzuzo yakho. Thepha lapha.
tip_no_sale_body: Awukathengisi namuhla? Thepha lapha ukubhala okukodwa — kudinga nje ukuskena.
intro_body: Ngithephe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngizokukhombisa indlela yokusebenzisa noma yini esesikrinini sakho. Ngihlala lapha phezulu uma udinga usizo.
sheet_subtitle: NginguStocky, umsizi wakho. Khetha okuthize, ngizokukhomba ngqo.
sheet_first_open: Umusha lapha? Thepha noma yimuphi umugqa ongezansi, ngizowukhanyisa esikrinini sakho ukuze wazi kahle ukuthi ukuphi.
settings_desc: Vumela u-Stocky, umsizi wakho, akukhombise izici ngezikhathi ezithile. Akusoze kwenzeke ngesikhathi sokuthengisa.
